    Drivers 玩家人數
    Shift length 遊戲時間
    Start with 0 coins. Each player rolls once per turn, including taxi draws. A failed draw places no taxi and passes immediately. A valid draw places the taxi; driving waits for that player’s next turn. Pending orders stay saved. Card rolls wait until the next turn. At time-up, follow the shortest legal route; no new cards. Most net coins wins, then most completed orders. Progress saves on this device.

    Starting a new shift replaces the saved game on this device.
